item.description:
Source91Mobiles OTT
LanguageHindi
CategoryOTT Release
Release Date04 Nov 2026

Blind Game follows a suspended IPS officer who is drawn into a mysterious case involving a group of friends and five crore rupees that have gone missing. What initially appears to be a straightforward investigation soon spirals into a dangerous and intricate web of secrets, deceit, and betrayal, where nothing is as it seems and every revelation leads to more questions.

item.title: [Hindi] [OTT Release] Haiwaan
item.description:
Source91Mobiles OTT
LanguageHindi
CategoryOTT Release
Release Date06 Nov 2026 (OTT)

A remake of the 2016 Malayalam film 'Oppam', 'Haiwaan' is a suspense thriller that revolves around a visually impaired man who works as a lift operator in a residential building. He finds himself as the prime suspect in a murder that takes place in one of the apartments. He must now race against time to find the real killer and protect a young girl from the relentless and psychotic murderer.
